Delivery Albert Heijn - Zwolle - € 18,83 per uur - 12 - 30 uur, 2 - 5 dagen per week - Geen - Albert Heijn Online 
On the road with your favorite music? Make it your job! Drive for Albert Heijn Online and earn €18,83 per hour (incl. holiday pay & ADV, 21+). 
You get freedom on the road, a physically active job, and your own delivery van. 
You just need a valid driver's license B. We ask you to work at least two days a week, including two Saturdays a month. Fridays and Saturdays are our most important days right now ! 
Stay for the long term and discover great opportunities to grow within the company. You can choose a morning shift (6:00/8:00 AM to 1:00/3:00 PM) or an evening shift (2:00/4:00 PM to 9:00/11:00 PM). 
Apply now and turn your drive into cash! 
 what we offer 
 A salary of €18,83 per hour! 
 A chance to get a contract with AH! 
 Informal work environment! 
 Travel expenses of €0,23 per km, up to 45 km! 
 Schedule your own shifts in the app! 
 Possibilities to develop yourself! 
 who you are 
As a delivery driver at Albert Heijn Online of course you have to have a driver's license B (min. 2 year). It's also nice to have some social skills, because you will have a lot of customer contact! Also: - You have to be available for at least two Saturdays a month and at least two days a week (at the moment Friday and Saturday is important) - A physically demanding job is not a problem for you - You speak Dutch or English 
 what will you do 
As a delivery driver at Albert Heijn Online, it's your job to deliver groceries at the customers' home. You will also complete the payment with the customer and take empty bottles with you. As a delivery driver, you get to see a lot of places in Zwolle. You drive around in a delivery van and make people happy! #baanrader You will have a lot of freedom on the road, because you work by yourself. But you start and finish your day together with your colleagues, a good combination!
